sloka: यद्यप्येष भवेद्भर्ता ममार्ये वृत्तवर्जित: ।अद्वैधमुपचर्तव्यस्तथाप्येष मया भवेत् ॥ २.११८.३॥
transliteration: yadyapyeṣa bhavedbhartā mamārye vṛttavarjita: ।advaidhamupacartavyastathāpyeṣa mayā bhavet ॥ 2.118.3॥

translations.english: O noble lady, even if my husband is devoid of good conduct, he should be obeyed without showing any hesitation.
